Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) [[,]] a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.  

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the bovine viral diarrhea virus Type lb is modified to enhance immunogenicity compared to the unmodified virus.  

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein all modified viruses are specifically adapted for inclusion in a bovine immunogenic composition.  

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, wherein the antigen is selected from the group consisting of viral, bacterial, or fungal antigens.  

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated, or is a live attenuated form with reduced pathogenicity.  

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim [[11]]4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen derived from or targeting BVDV strains circulating in bovine populations.
